title: DataraTypeSystemSchema
description: Comprehensive schema of Datara types, memory representations, semantics, and subtyping rules.

primitive_types.name: Str
primitive_types.description: UTF-8 byte buffer with length (fat pointer: ptr + len)

primitive_types.name: Void
primitive_types.description: Unit return type for side-effecting operations without output

composite_types.name: List<T>
composite_types.description: Contiguous dynamically resizable vector with zero-cost indexing and slice views

composite_types.name: Capability<Cap>
composite_types.description: Zero-cost static witness token granting access to restricted OS effects (FileRead, FileWrite, NetworkConnect, ProcessExec)

composite_types.name: NativeWindow
composite_types.description: Native OS window container with canvas drawing

composite_types.name: VNode
composite_types.description: Virtual DOM node with diff-patch algorithm

nominal_and_adt.memory_layout: Class with domain identity and lifecycle tracking
Zero runtime overhead inlined fields into host class/entity

coercion_rules.implicit_casts: NONE. Datara forbids silent numeric promotion or lossy casts.
coercion_rules.explicit_casts: Use 'as' operator (e.g., 3.14 as Int) or math functions (math_floor, math_round).
coercion_rules.boolean_eval: No truthiness for integers or pointers. Explicit comparisons required (if x != 0).

refinements.name: FVRP Range Refinement
refinements.llvm_lowering: Emits @llvm.assume and !range metadata nodes (!{i64 min, i64 max})

refinements.name: Units of Measure
refinements.llvm_lowering: Zero-overhead abstraction lowered directly to native double
